messages.subject: speed issues
parts: I have a simple app that renders results for text and part of a dataframe  (mlgi.shinyspps.io/protest/). I am trying to publish all the rows after selecting key columns.  When I use the shiny library everything works as expected. However once I use the shinyapp library the rendering of the main panel slows down dramatically . This is the case whether I am using a local version of the software or the alpha version on shinapps.io. version. In the latter instance it is not unusual for nothing at all to appear in the mainpanel. Is this a general problem or am I doing something unwise? (The table has dimensions of 473 X 10).

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] speed issues
parts:
Michael,

I believe this is UTF-8 encoding problem. If I check the javascript console when I load your app I see:

  1. Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token N shiny.js:764
    1. dispatchMessageshiny.js:764
    2. socket.onmessageshiny.js:491
    3. d.dispatchEventsockjs-0.3.min.js:27
    4. y._dispatchMessagesockjs-0.3.min.js:27
    5. y._didMessagesockjs-0.3.min.js:27
    6. e.ws.onmessage

If I recall correctly, this can be caused by the fact that ShinyApps by default is not using a UTF-8 encoding, and your app is attempting to read UTF-8 encoded data. 

This is obviously an issue with ShinyApps that we need to fix. However the work around right now is to add a file to your application called ".Renviron". That file should have the text:

LANG="C.UTF-8"
